purpose: 추가 화면 제작 참고 시안. Figma 편집 가능한 화면 완료 아님.
stylePrompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a single polished Korean mobile app UI screenshot, logical size exactly 390px width and tall 844px minimum, white background, no phone shell, no outer margins, no labels outside the UI. Match Holdlog visual style: Noto Sans KR typeface, 20px horizontal padding, bold 32px large black title, muted blue-gray #515B80 body, vivid purple #512AFF active controls, pale #F3F4F7 inputs, thin pale dividers, round 12px surfaces, spare roomy simple functional interface. Header with slim back chevron. No bottom navigation because this is a subpage. No invented errors/loading/empty states, no banners, no instruction text not requested. All Korean text crisp and exact.
